name: rust-monorepo-orchestrator
description: Methodology-first multi-agent refactoring orchestrator for monorepos. Spawns parallel waves of Opus-orchestrated, Sonnet-implemented subagents that drill a domain top-to-bottom (HTTP commands -> events -> views -> inter-service events), document architecture violations, author project-specific ast-grep rules, then run a wave of isolated-worktree workers with claim-lock concurrency, automerge on verifier-pass, and dead-letter on failure. v0.7.0 is context-aware: scripts/discover-workspace.sh walks up from cwd to find the workspace and detects services + aggregates automatically; commands take zero path arguments by default. Service-level by default: /audit-domain <service> drills ALL aggregates in parallel (cartographer per aggregate, hunter per aggregate*axis); /plan-refactor <service> produces ONE unified PLAN.md with cross-aggregate depends_on and de-duplicated shared-infrastructure tickets; /run-wave-ralph <service> drives a single inbox. New /migrate command runs the full pipeline (/init -> /audit -> /plan -> decisions gate -> /run) end-to-end. Reasoning gates at every phase. Two wave runners: /run-wave (subagent-driven) and /run-wave-ralph (bash Ralph loop, no nested-Agent dispatch, disk-resumable, live monitor). Ralph mode side-loads five per-session hooks via --settings: SessionStart injects the worker's exact workspace tree + NEEDED_FILES; PreToolUse(Edit|Write|NotebookEdit) blocks out-of-scope edits; Stop auto-commits with conventional-commits message. Workers share CARGO_TARGET_DIR for 5-10x Rust compile. Tickets marked verifier:deterministic skip the LLM verifier (~40-50% verifier cost saved). Filesystem inbox; HANDOFF.md cross-phase contract; subagent memory; auto-loaded prompting and orchestration skills. Stack-agnostic by design. Nine slash commands (/init, /audit-domain, /plan-refactor, /run-wave, /run-wave-ralph, /migrate, /status, /replay, /sweep-rules), nine subagents, three methodology skills.
